text: Mags Tallow, keeper of the book. Sit down and buy a drink, or stand up and buy one for me.
Well, well. Come to make some honest Brethren money?
Every name in Saltmarrow is in my book, {player}. Yours too. Want to know what it says?
There's my favourite captain! Sit down, the good bottle's under the counter.
Turncoat. You've got some nerve. Talk fast, there's people here who'd love an excuse.
Smells like Tidewatch in here. Oh, it's you. Sit down, we don't judge. Much.
Listen to that thunder. Nobody sane is at sea tonight.
Storm's right on top of us. Stay in the dry a while.
Every timber in the harbour's groaning. Ugly night.
Wretched rain. Gets into everything.
Rain again. Good for the cisterns, bad for the soul.
You're dripping on my floor, by the way.
Late to be wandering about.
Night's when the cursed come walking. Keep a lantern lit.
Can't sleep either, eh?
Up with the gulls, I see.
Early start, {player}.
Mist'll burn off by mid-morning.

options.label: What does my name say in your book?

text: It says you've done some things and you'll do more. Write a bigger page, captain.
It says 'friend of the Brethren', underlined twice. I only underline once for most.
It says you pay your debts and sink the right ships. That's a good line in this book.
It says 'watch this one'. Three times.
Articles signed by every captain, a vote for every crew, and a share for every hand. The Brethren are the closest thing the Reach has to a fair deal.
Do Brethren contracts, sink Tidewatch patrols, keep the cursed off our lanes. You'll rise. Ranks come with presents.
Born in this tavern, likely die in it. I keep the book because I can read and nobody else could be bothered.
Sailed with three captains, buried two. The third owes me money, so I keep him alive out of spite.
